governance_note: The EU-residency distinction that makes Mistral / Le Chat interesting applies equally here. The difference from the open-weight models is that this one cannot be self-hosted, so the data path runs through Mistral's infrastructure. That is still a significantly simpler transfer analysis than a US provider for a European organization, but it is not the same as self-hosting an Apache-licensed weight.
